note: Owned by the category manager (cm-behavioral, Rasmus); charter company/domains/behavioral.md; sign-off requests company/domains/behavioral-signoffs.md. Domain id 'behavioral' is a PROPOSAL: platform-engineer decides the DomainId at playbook step 8 (W-981); until content/domains.json lists it, npm run check does not validate this file. Drafted 2026-10-15 by cm-behavioral from the DLR (company/domains/proposals/2026-10-15-behavioral-economics-dlr.md) and head-of-product's rulings (company/decisions/2026-10-15-behavioral-economics-dlr-decision.md). No subarea: no strands at this size. demand: 1 low, 3 high; EVERY value is an estimate (demandEstimate: true), not learner data: the counted concepts carry domain-scout's DLR estimates, the reserves cm-behavioral's. level: intro | core | stretch. reserve: true = not counted and not briefed until a counted concept is struck and the reserve's own boundary line is signed. pilot: the DLR five in head-of-product's order (1-3 after the fact-checker's step-9 statement; 4 after cm-books signs, fallback reflection-effect; 5 after cm-economics signs); no sixth brief before the DLR reconvenes. claimTypes: a derivation, b the learner's own screen, c disclosed seeded simulation, d source plus replication verdict (charter, checking section). nearest: the closest existing concept in any category (a brief says how it differs). boundary: which neighbour rows it depends on, the close-call line if any, who signs, and status, copied from behavioral-signoffs.md on 2026-10-15 (signoffs: one entry per sign-off line with verdict and conditions; rowSignoffs: the row-wide lines). A condition is binding on the brief; if a brief breaks one, that signature lapses. 11 counted concepts after #12 money-illusion was dropped on the E9 objection (see `dropped`). contested: true = taught only as contested, never as a predict answer. held: why the concept cannot be briefed even after its row is signed. Prerequisites link neighbour concepts by domain:id; nothing is moved or re-tagged out of a neighbour. reviewRoute: 'sensitive' where a reveal would compare groups or countries (the sensitive-topics route, company/international/sensitive-topics-checklist.md), 'standard' otherwise.
